scenes.title: Invoices, payments and payment links
scenes.subtitle: Get paid, and know who still owes you
scenes.narration: Money in, money owed, and the paperwork that goes with it. Here is the finance side of TravelCRM Pro.
Invoices and proformas in one list. Filter to overdue and you see straight away who needs a reminder.
Create an invoice for the customer, add lines with their tax codes, and the GST and totals work themselves out.
The invoice page shows what was billed, what has been paid and what is left, and downloads as a PDF or a spreadsheet.
Send the invoice on WhatsApp or email through the communication hub, with a template and a preview. Reminders before the due date are queued for you each morning.
Connect your own Razorpay or Stripe account, and every invoice can carry a pay-online link. When the customer pays through it, the payment is recorded on the invoice by itself.
Void a mistake or duplicate an invoice from the actions menu, and download a batch of invoices as PDFs in one go.
Record a payment against the invoice with the method and the bank reference. The balance and the status update at once, and a receipt is ready.
Refunds and extra charges go on credit and debit notes against the original invoice, so the books stay right.
Set your bank details, payment terms, default tax and your own number series for invoices, receipts and vouchers.
